name: charm
description: Charm skills for Claude Code: charm-planning (generate a stacked-PR handoff brief inside a charm session); charm-write-project-brief and charm-update-project-brief (author and refresh the per-project operational briefs `charm start --project` injects); plus the charm-restart and charm-reset-kb operator skills. Installed into ~/.claude/skills/charm/ by `frieren install`; this repo's plugin/ directory is the canonical source.
